title: 5 STARS
text: We loved our experience with Petra (Carpe Diem Tours). We felt as though we were being guided by a friend. She managed to keep our kids (9 & 10 years old) interested (!), and gave us some flexibility in the pace of the tour. We didn’t feel rushed at all and she gave us lots of interesting info on the Gothic Quarter + El Born, plus suggestions on restaurants, which were awesome. We highly recommend this tour, and hope you get Petra as your guide. My son rated our tour 5 stars. :)
author: F4356XYjonathand

title: The best tour ever!
text: Daniel is fantastic! He is so knowledgeable and funny and sensitive. He told us what was meaningful to him about each place we visited and the emotional tone is part of what I remember as I reflect on the tour— like the kids who are playing in the church square where they had been bombed in an earlier part of history - and how people here give each other roses and books to celebrate Saint George as we discussed it in between the govt buildings and discussing Bakunin and Franco as we looked at the bullet holes in the buildings and how Jewish cemeteries were desecrated and you can see the Hebrew
